title: Drug Use Investigation for Cervarix®
brief_summary: This post-marketing study was designed to assess safety and efficacy of Cervarix® vaccine in Japanese female subjects under conditions of actual use.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject must be female
* Subject must be aged 10 and over

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject with obvious fever
* Subject with obvious severe acute disease
* Subject with hypersensitivity to any component of Cervarix®
* Other than above, subject who is in inappropriate conditions for vaccination
study_population: Japanese women who received Cervarix® for the first time
